applicableAreas: entire site - transmission facilities present on Valley View Road and property boundaries
findings.comment: Electric Transmission Notes on Sheet 3 explicitly require 'A pre-construction safety meeting is required with Austin Energy 48 hours before commencement of construction' with specific contact information provided (Andrew Perez at 512-505-7133). However, no documentation demonstrates that this required safety meeting has been scheduled or completed prior to submission.

applicableAreas: transmission structures on western and southern boundaries adjacent to construction limits
findings.comment: Electric Transmission Notes require 'Barricades must be erected 10 feet from electric transmission structures during construction.' Existing utility poles with guy wires are shown on the existing survey, but the erosion control plan does not provide specific details showing where 10-foot barricades will be placed or how this requirement will be implemented during construction.

applicableAreas: overhead transmission lines on western boundary (Valley View Road) and southern boundary
findings.comment: Electric Transmission Notes require 'Warning signs must be placed under the overhead electric transmission facilities as notification of the electrical hazard.' Overhead utility lines are present on the property boundary, but construction or erosion control plans do not show where warning signs will be placed under these overhead lines.

applicableAreas: entire construction limits - grading near transmission structures shown on eastern, southern, and western boundaries
findings.comment: Electric Transmission Notes explicitly require 'Grading near electric transmission facilities must be coordinated with Austin Energy prior to commencement of grading. Call Andrew Perez at 512-505-7133 to schedule a meeting.' Grading plans show extensive work throughout the site near transmission structures, easements, and guy wires, but no documentation of Austin Energy coordination, approval, or meeting completion is provided in the submittals.

applicableAreas: areas within 25 feet of transmission structures and guy anchors including eastern and southern property boundaries where retaining walls are proposed
findings.comment: Excavation greater than 1 foot in depth within 25 feet of transmission structures requires Austin Energy evaluation and approval. Grading plan shows retaining wall construction and site grading within 25 feet of transmission structures, poles, and guy anchor locations on the eastern and southern boundaries, but no documentation of Austin Energy review or approval of these excavation/construction activities is provided.

applicableAreas: landscaped areas near transmission structures - entire site within 25-foot evaluation zone
findings.comment: Irrigation sprinkler locations cannot be verified on the submitted landscape plan. The irrigation notes explicitly state 'THE IRRIGATION INSTALLER SHALL DEVELOP AND PROVIDE AN AS-BUILT DESIGN PLAN TO THE CITY AT THE TIME THE FINAL IRRIGATION INSPECTION IS PERFORMED,' indicating that sprinkler head locations and system details are deferred to a future as-built plan. Compliance with the 25-foot prohibition on sprinklers near transmission structures cannot be verified at this stage.

applicableAreas: northwest corner of property where guy wire is visible on existing utility pole on Valley View Road
findings.comment: Existing guy wire and anchor (down guy) are shown on the existing conditions survey (Sheet 4) but specific guy anchor locations are not depicted on the construction/grading plans. Proposed site improvements and retaining walls must maintain required clearances from these support structures, but the exact anchor locations are not shown on the working plans needed for contractor implementation.

applicableAreas: trees proposed along western boundary (within 25 feet of utility poles on Valley View Road) and southern boundary (within 10-20 feet of overhead transmission line marked OHE)
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows multiple trees (marked as ST - Street Yard Trees and M - Mitigation Trees) planted within 50 feet of transmission facilities. However, specific tree species are not identified on the plan, and there is no verification that any of these trees are utility-compatible (UC) species marked as 'UC' in ECM Appendix F with mature heights ≤20 feet. Applicant must specify species for all trees within 50 feet of transmission and verify UC designation.

applicableAreas: roads and driveways proposed within transmission easements on site
findings.comment: Electric Transmission Notes state that 'Roads/driveways/pavement/parking within the easement should be built to support a 46,000 lb tandem axle (5 foot spacing).' Grading plans show site improvements including driveways and pavements on the property near transmission easements, but no pavement design sheets or engineering calculations demonstrating the 46,000-48,000 pound tandem axle load capacity are provided.
